concepts.def: Force between point charges: F = Q₁Q₂/(4πε₀r²).
Force per unit positive charge at a point: E = F/Q, measured in N C⁻¹ or V m⁻¹.
Field between parallel plates: E = V/d, with field lines straight and equally spaced.
Work done per unit charge to bring a positive charge from infinity: V = Q/(4πε₀r).
Surface on which electric potential is constant; no work is done moving along it.
ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² F m⁻¹, characterising vacuum's ability to permit electric fields.
